import math

# Data from FY 1945-1959 based on treasury bulletins
# From 1954 bulletin for 1945-1947, from 1960 bulletin for 1948-1959
data = [
    -53941,  # 1945 (from 1954 bulletin)
    -20676,  # 1946 (from 1954 bulletin)
    754,     # 1947 (from 1954 bulletin)
    8419,    # 1948
    -1811,   # 1949
    -3122,   # 1950
    3510,    # 1951
    -4017,   # 1952
    -9449,   # 1953
    -3117,   # 1954
    -4180,   # 1955
    1626,    # 1956
    1596,    # 1957
    -2819,   # 1958
    -12427   # 1959
]

print("Fiscal Year Surplus/Deficit (in millions):")
for i, year in enumerate(range(1945, 1960)):
    print(f"FY {year}: {data[i]}")

# Calculate sample standard deviation
n = len(data)
mean = sum(data) / n
print(f"\nMean: {mean}")

# Calculate variance (sample standard deviation uses n-1)
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in data) / (n - 1)
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)

print(f"Sample Standard Deviation: {std_dev}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest thousandths: {std_dev:.3f}")
EOF

std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)

print(f"\nn = {n}")
print(f"Mean = {mean}")
print(f"Variance (sample) = {variance}")
print(f"Sample Std Dev = {std_dev:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places = {std_dev:.3f}")
